title: Caterpie Homes
description: This datapack brings you the fully decorated command structure Caterpie with three styles!
body:
Caterpie will wait for you!

This datapack brings you the **fully decorated** command structure Caterpie with three styles! ## 🪞 Three Styles
Name Caterpie House Caterpie Trunk Caterpie
Description Caterpie on top of their Trunk and with Old Taiga Woods (very tiny) around. Caterpie on top of their Trunk. Caterpie alone.
/place structure pokehouse: caterpiehouse caterpietrunk caterpie
## 🏯 Plenty room for your _homy_ needs This Caterpie brings you with plenty of _room_ for you to use and enjoy! ### 🪑 The first floor of both Caterpie House & Trunk offers you a cozy trunk environment with a in-door field, a kitchen and a enchanting table ready to be used!
### 🪜 The second floor of all Caterpies offers you with a cozy escalated room for you to rest and enjoy leisure time.
#### ⛺ Standalone Caterpie also offers you with a built-in kitchen and entrance!
## ⚠️ Requirements - Minecraft Java (presummably) from 1.20.5 to 1.21.11. ## 🚫 Attention - To ensure not losing any previous structure close to you, we suggest you place the caterpies away from any other structure to avoid misplacing and losing any previous builds. - Since this is a command-only structure (for now, at least), please do not use `/locate structure` command on these Caterpies, the game will not find any and will freeze too, **having to close the game forcefully**.
